title: Privacy Policy
paragraphs: IntiGuttu.com does not require an account and does not use tracking or advertising cookies.
The only thing stored in your browser is your cookie-notice choice, saved locally on your device using localStorage - it is never sent to us.

If you submit the Contribute or Feedback form, the name and message you enter are sent to a private Google Sheet (via a Google Apps Script Web App) so we can review contributions and feedback. This information is used only for that review and, where relevant, to publish your contribution - it is not sold or shared with third parties.
If you have questions about this policy, reach out using the Feedback option in the footer.
